risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the Xbox Live service.
risks.proof: A photo of the console's 'System Storage' screen showing the 'Xbox Live' status.

response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an Xbox One S console from the photos. It can be priced at its worst case (not working) until proof of functionality is provided.
